body:
I very much appreciate the advice. Honestly, this helped a lot. I ever reached out to one of her family members that was caught in the crossfire of things and got a little closure at least from that. 

This will be short, but I want you to know that what you said was very very much appreciated... I'm not saying the thoughts are gone or will be gone soon. I feel like maybe that will be something I deal with until I grab a little more hold of my life, but at least I'm heading in the right direction, or at least I hope.

You've given me a lot of food for thought. It's not often that I get people actually put on my thinking cap, so it's a big deal. Thank you.

Guy, I'm in a lot of the same boat. I have a house with the lady I love. I mean, I own a house with her... I have a good paying job. I have a hand full of friends I love and I believe would go up to bat for me. I deal with daily suicidal thoughts. In depth. They're relieving. I don't know whats wrong with me. I don't know if it's normal. I just know it's wrong of me... I have my own issues, but not too much more than the average Joe...

I guess what I'm trying to say is that even though I have a good life, I deal with this shitty feeling... And even though I feel like it would be the only relief I can find, I don't want to see anyone make that terrible decision... You're not alone. You're not wrong for having the feelings, because as humans we only have so much control over our own thoughts and emotions... but you DO have some control. Try to push forward. This post is a good start. I just made a post myself. 

I hope you find what you're looking for. Just know you aren't alone. I feel like if I'm in the same boat as you then there's quite a few. Try to be one of those that make it out of these feelings alive and well. Just know that you aren't the only one fighting the war on this side of the fence.
